development.whole_panel_common_eligibility: signal date t qualifies only when next-session entry and all ten holding sessions exist in the registered trading-date calendar, all required bars finite/valid; no outcome-based exclusion; untestable rows recorded
development.in_run_byte_readback: REQUIRED_BEFORE_REAL_ACCESS; existing registrations certify historical identity, fresh storage download not yet performed

factor.name: LIQ_ADJUSTED_PRICE
factor.tails: same-date finite frozen112-symbol cross section; inclusive p20 LOW / p80 HIGH; linear quantile interpolation

horizons.horizon_selection: none; every architecture treated as inseparable cap5/7/10 family with equal weights and all caps reported; paths1..10 diagnostic only

entry.decision_time: after official RTH close on t
entry.price: next available registered session adjusted open(t+1)
entry.counting: entry session is holding day1, time exit at official adjusted close of holding day cap
entry.real_adjusted_price_limitation: retrospectively split-adjusted research coordinate, not as-traded nominal price; no claim of executable share counts or borrow availability
entry.reentry: independent daily event cohorts; overlapping positions are not represented as an implementable self-financing portfolio

architectures.trailing: 2% from best completed holding-session close; ratchet after close effective next session; never use current high/low to ratchet same session

long prior5 completed session lows max-ratchet / short prior5 completed session highs min-ratchet; active next session; extra predictor warmup means common signal-date eligibility needs prior5 sessions

path_execution.barrier_coordinates: fraction of actual adjusted entry open; short favorable price decrease, adverse increase
path_execution.gap_rule: check opening price before daily high/low; execute at opening price when crossing active barrier; profit target gap conservatively fill at target, adverse stop gap at worse opening price
path_execution.same_session_double_hit: stop first conservative convention; separately flag unresolvable OHLC ordering and report target-first sensitivity diagnostically; no inferred intraday path
path_execution.force_exit: at cap close, cap<=10; barrier event takes precedence before closing time exit
path_execution.short_return: (entry-exit)/entry; simple not leveraged; short sale borrow/locate/corporate-action execution unavailable and S4 gate
path_execution.missing: retain audit row UNTESTABLE_DATA; never impute a price, extrapolate, pick another date, or remove because result unfavorable

metrics.primary: date-level equal-weight eligible-symbol arithmetic mean of net simple side return divided by held sessions, then equal-weight cap5/7/10 within side/architecture; mean across common eligible signal dates
secondary: MFE and MAE relative to entry for full1..10 path and pre-exit bar envelope with ordering censor flag
cumulative date-cohort PnL and maximum drawdown labeled cohort-index not implementable portfolio
paired dailyized difference to same-side TIME per cap and equal-weight family diagnostic
metrics.MFE_MAE: signed favorable and adverse excursion from entry to exit using known completed bars; exit-session unobserved sequence cannot identify pre-exit excursion; report conservative bounds/censored diagnostic, never exact intraday claim
metrics.first_passage: opening crossings known first; intra-session high/low crossings only daily interval resolution; joint stop/target crossings flagged and deterministic conservative fill; no unobserved timestamps
metrics.dailyized: simple net return divided by held trading sessions; no annualization primary; geometric holding-rate diagnostic only when1+return>0
metrics.drawdown: from cumulative equal-weight date-cohort net total-return index; no portfolio-capital claim

inference.aggregation: symbol events averaged within signal-date, caps equal-weighted within side/architecture; no per-symbol independence
inference.primary_family: 2 sides x6 architecture families =12 tests; unavailable retain conservative p1 bookkeeping slot
inference.HAC: Newey-West Bartlett lag9 for every family due shared max10 holding sessions
inference.reference: asymptotic normal two-sided95% CI; no small-sample multiplier
inference.materiality: proposed positive family mean / sampleSD(date-family dailyized return), ddof1 >=0.20; this S3 translation requires canonical approval, not inherited validation of trading leg

robustness.temporal: 4 common chronological blocks fixed on predictor/common endpoint eligibility before outcomes; >=3 positive blocks and maximum abs(block_mean*blockN)/sum<=0.50
robustness.symbol: additive daily cohort contributions reconcile; top1/5/10 absolute shares, HHI; remove top5 deterministic abs desc symbol asc then recompute all caps/family; no sign reversal, zero not reversal; primary never drops symbols
robustness.horizon: all3 cap-specific mean net dailyized side effects positive; no best-cap selection; cap-specific inferential results diagnostic only
robustness.ambiguity: stop-first primary; target-first sensitivity never replaces primary

costs.application: subtract fixed entry-notional round-trip bps once/event; divide resulting net by held sessions
costs.semantics: scenario assumptions only, no empirical spread/market-impact/borrow inference; S4 certifies fills/gaps/nominal prices/borrow/fees/tax/dividends/execution stress; no selection of cost scenario

dispositions.NO_S4_SUPPORT: valid testable; positive direction, materiality or BH gate fails
dispositions.DEVELOPMENT_ONLY_WEAK: all primary gates pass but any required robustness gate fails
dispositions.ELIGIBLE_FOR_CANONICAL_S4_REVIEW: all primary and robustness gates pass; not independently validated or automatically advanced

selection.rule: among ELIGIBLE_FOR_CANONICAL_S4_REVIEW only: descending lower95% HAC CI of equal-weight cap-family primary net dailyized mean; exact ties fixed architecture ID lexicographic; report all36 cells regardless selection
selection.risk: drawdown and path metrics fully reported, no unplanned risk weighting or threshold
selection.S4_transition: separate canonical approval, no automatic queue; S5/S6 locked

S5.protected_interval: all dates after2026-08-27 outside approved development deny by default; consumed pre2025-02-03 validation separately denied
S5.recommended_start_rule: first common source trading session on or after2026-10-05 AND strictly after full S4 candidate freeze timestamp converted to NewYork date; no decision outcomes before that anchor; no retrospective backfill for sample selection
S5.recommended_sample: first126 prospectively eligible signal dates from anchor plus up to10 endpoint sessions; fixed enrolment/certification before outcomes; no result-based extension; acquisition/identity/PIT universe/source semantics separately governed
S5.development_exclusion: S3/S4 cannot inspect any S5 bars/outcomes; use same development object only unless prospectively authorized additional development input is permanently marked consumed

verification.required: all output immutable private objects; exactly1 primary summary; every SHA/bytes independently downloaded/read back and SQL UTF8/blob parity verified; exact research/infrastructure/job/attempt/run/job revisions reconciled; no recursive manifest hash; terminal MWE reread; failures preserved

exit_gates:
S3 may be marked COMPLETE and S4 considered only when ALL are satisfied:
1. A prospective S3 protocol and any supplements were frozen before the corresponding S3 candidate outcomes were inspected.
2. Exact S3 development inputs and data-use boundaries are registered and verified, with no consumed B5 validation sample used for parameter/candidate selection and no protected holdout accessed.
3. LIQ_ADJUSTED_PRICE semantics are either preserved exactly or any change is explicitly treated as a new exploratory hypothesis without inherited B5 validation status.
4. All prespecified S3 candidate architectures and parameter cells are accounted for; no favorable-result deletion or post-hoc grid expansion occurred.
5. Required holding-path outputs are complete for the applicable 1-10 day envelope: total return, dailyized return, MFE, MAE, first passage/time-to-target and exit/stop behavior as prospectively defined.
6. Long and short sides are separately reported; no aggregate result conceals a failing side.
7. Temporal stability, symbol concentration and leave-contributor diagnostics are complete, with the inherited concentration concern explicitly reported rather than optimized away.
8. Any transaction-cost/slippage diagnostics required by the S3 protocol are complete and clearly labeled preliminary; S4 retains final execution-stress authority.
9. S3 produces a bounded candidate set with fully specified entry/exit/holding semantics and a mechanical disposition for every preregistered candidate. It is acceptable for S3 to conclude that no candidate merits S4.
10. Candidate selection, if any, follows the prospectively frozen rule and does not claim independent validation from S3 development evidence.
11. All required artifacts, hashes/bytes, job/attempt/revision provenance and independent readbacks are durably reconciled.
12. S4 entry, if recommended, carries forward only the bounded S3 candidate(s), unresolved limitations and frozen rules; S5 remains the untouched out-of-sample validation stage and S6 remains locked.
